name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
image_match: Leverage_Iso_Row. The photo shows the bilateral grip and chest-pad position on a plate-loaded row. The linked demonstration shows the prescribed pin-loaded machine.
video_source: Life FitnessTraining, Insignia Series Row demonstration.
form_cues: Adjust the pad so you can reach both handles with your chest supported.
Keep wrists straight and draw both elbows toward your sides.
Maintain contact with the chest pad as you pull and return.
instructions: Choose a pin-loaded row with a chest pad. Set the pin with the stack resting. Adjust the seat and pad so your feet are stable and the handles are within reach.
Rest your chest against the pad and take both handles with a secure grip. Use the neutral handles if available and comfortable.
Draw both elbows back toward your sides at the same pace. Keep your shoulders down and chest in contact with the pad.
Let both handles move forward slowly within a comfortable range. Settle the stack before releasing your grip.
notes: Use the pin-loaded version shown in the demonstration. Record the marked load on your machine and follow your weekly plan for reps and symptom limits.
